title: Perfect
text: Perfect. Was looking for gravity grinders where grind was adjustable. Gave as gift. May have to buy a set for myself!

product_metadata.title: Gravity Electric Salt Pepper Grinder - Automatic Battery Powered, Adjustable Coarseness, Blue LED Light, Great Mother’s Day Gift, Premium Quality Electronic Black Pepper Mill (Stainless Steel, 1 unit)
features: NEW MODERN DESIGN : Spice up your kitchen with our beautiful brushed stainless steel pepper grinder mill. This is a NEW DESIGN that is significantly better quality than most of the designs available on the market today - the parts fit together seamlessly, the components are higher quality, is it easy to open to refill or to change batteries. It’s a beautiful design that will be a highlight of your kitchen and attract the compliments of your family & guests!

EASY TO USE, ONE HANDED OPERATION: Convenient one handed operation, spice your food effortlessly at the push of a button. You can spice your food easily while you cook, you can spice even while you hold a lid or spoon with your other hand. Experience the convenience and speed of our electric grinders. Great for elderly customers with ARTHRITIS or HAND PAIN - no more twisting to grind your pepper. PRODUCT INSTRUCTIONS: See "User Guide" on this page.

ADJUSTABLE GRIND COARSENESS: Add a pop of extra flavor to any meal with our premium quality grinders! This grinder features a NEW grind adjustment mechanism that is more robust - you can easily adjust the grind settings by turning the bottom portion of the grinder to left or right. You don’t need to turn the grinder upside down anymore to rotate the ceramic grinder knob by hand. Try the different settings and experience the difference to your flavors!

PROFESSIONAL QUALITY: The Brushed Stainless Steel body & Acrylic chamber design make the grinder extremely durable, with no risk of glass breakages. The high quality ceramic rotor mechanism offers long term durability and will hold up against the toughest peppercorns, Himalayan salt or other spices. BOTTOM LED LIGHT: Features a strong LED bottom light that will make it easy for you to see how much spice you are adding to your food.
